sections.title: Seasons
sections.description: What each season has meant for this farm.

sections.title: Farm Notes
sections.description: Gentle guidance shaped by your philosophy.

pages.title: Spring Turning
pages.hint: Welcome spring as the season begins.

text.default: New shoots always feel like a promise. The soil wakes up softly.
text.nature: The earth listens first in spring. Let the fields lead the pace.
text.market: Spring is for smart starts. Early crops set the tone for sales.
text.slow: Spring breathes in. Take it slow and savor the first sprouts.

text.default: Long light stretches across the rows. Growth feels eager.
text.nature: Summer hums with energy. Follow the sun and the wind.
text.market: Heat brings demand. Keep a steady harvest rhythm.
text.slow: The days are long, but the farm can still move gently.

text.default: Fields glow with quiet abundance. The air smells like harvest.
text.nature: Autumn is a soft thank you. Leave room for the land to rest.
text.market: Peak season means peak prices. Plan your baskets well.
text.slow: Let the harvest be unhurried. Warm light makes the work sweet.

pages.title: Winter Quiet
pages.hint: Let winter settle on the farm.

text.default: Silence gathers along the fences. Even the barn breathes softly.
text.nature: Winter teaches patience. Let the fields sleep in peace.
text.market: Scarcity sharpens value. Keep a careful eye on stocks.
text.slow: Winter is for warm tea and small tasks done with care.

pages.title: Full Circle
pages.hint: Experience every season at least once.

text.default: The farm has turned through every season. The rhythm feels familiar now.
text.nature: Seasons are the farm’s heartbeat. You’ve learned its steady pulse.
text.market: A full cycle reveals the trends. You know when to push and when to pause.
text.slow: A year’s worth of moments now lives here. Cozy and complete.

text.default: Rain leaves the soil tender. Harvests feel gentler in the hush.
text.nature: The rain sings for the roots. You listened and gathered softly.
text.market: Rain days can still pay. A calm harvest keeps the ledger warm.
text.slow: Rain makes everything slower and sweeter. Let the drops keep time.

text.default: You stood with the farm through wild weather. The fields remember.
text.nature: Storms are a reminder of the sky’s power. You stayed grounded.
text.market: Storms test planning. You kept the farm steady anyway.
text.slow: Even storms pass. You waited it out with a steady heart.

text.default: Every kind of sky has visited your farm. You can read its moods now.
text.nature: The weather has told you its stories. You learned each one.
text.market: Knowing the sky means knowing the market. You plan with confidence.
text.slow: You’ve watched the sky change and found peace in each shift.

text.default: Something still grew in the cold. Your farm is patient and brave.
text.nature: Winter harvests are rare gifts. You treated them with care.
text.market: Off-season crops fetch attention. You found value in the cold.
text.slow: A winter harvest is a quiet joy. Warm hands, warm heart.

pages.title: A Reliable Favorite
pages.hint: Harvest the same crop across three seasons.

text.default: One crop keeps returning to your fields. A faithful favorite.
text.nature: Some plants just belong here. You found one that stays.
text.market: Reliable crops keep the ledger calm. Consistency looks good.
text.slow: There’s comfort in the familiar. A favorite, season after season.

text.default: The town gathered, and so did you. The farm feels less alone.
text.nature: Festivals remind the land it’s shared. You felt the warmth.
text.market: Festivals bring opportunities and stories. You showed up.
text.slow: A night of lanterns, a heart full of quiet joy.

text.default: The town knows your footsteps now. You’re part of the rhythm.
text.nature: Seasonal gatherings ground the year. You came each time.
text.market: Showing up builds trust. Your stall is becoming familiar.
text.slow: The festivals feel like home now. A cozy tradition.

pages.title: First Steps
pages.hint: Harvest your first crop or visit the Town Board.

text.default: Every farm begins with a small, steady rhythm. You found yours.
text.nature: The first harvest is a quiet promise. Let the land guide the next.
text.market: A first win on the ledger sets the pace. Keep it gentle and smart.
text.slow: Small wins feel big here. Let the farm unfold softly.

text.default: You chose a gentle direction. Let it guide the small decisions.
text.nature: Follow the land’s quiet cues. They’ll guide you well.
text.market: Keep your eyes on the trends. Small margins add up.
text.slow: Let the farm be a place of calm. Move at the speed of comfort.

pages.title: Morning Notes
pages.hint: Let a new day begin on the farm.

text.default: Each morning adds a new line to the farm’s story.
text.nature: A new day means new signals from the land.
text.market: A fresh day is a fresh plan. Check the ledger and the sky.
text.slow: Morning light feels like a soft promise. Start gently.

text.default: Small rituals are taking root. The farm feels steady.
text.nature: With each day, the land learns your rhythm.
text.market: Consistency keeps the farm strong. The routine is paying off.
text.slow: A calm routine is a quiet treasure. You’re finding it.

pages.title: Festival Rhythm
pages.hint: Find your timing at a festival.

text.default: You found the rhythm the town keeps in its harvest songs.
text.nature: Timing comes from listening. The fields kept the beat with you.
text.market: Good timing turns small chances into steady wins.
text.slow: You matched the festival’s gentle tempo. Cozy and bright.
